blocking_uncertainty: The June label-free local polynomial EDMD control has strong historical outputs, but its evaluator and raw evidence were removed from the maintained paper workflow during repository cleanup.
hypothesis: A behavior-preserving port of commit c27490d reproduces the authenticated June row grid, validation-selected route counts, and aggregate metrics within the tolerances frozen below.
competing_explanations: The historical result depended on code or dependency state that the current repository no longer reproduces.
The route-count result was accidentally label- or known-basin-count-dependent.
Numerical drift changes K-means assignments or the selected route count even when the written protocol is unchanged.
known_outcome_notice: This is not a prospective confirmation. All June outcomes and both historical scratch roots were inspected before this card was frozen.

protocol.method: degree-3 polynomial EDMD behind state-space k-means routes
protocol.selection: minimum mean log cumulative rollout MSE over all report horizons on a deterministic 25% held-out subset of training trajectories; ties prefer smaller k
protocol.refit: refit selected k on the complete training split
protocol.rollout: decode the predicted state and reroute that predicted state before every next local EDMD update
protocol.labels_and_counts: No basin labels, attractor identities, known basin counts, or fixed basin count enter fitting, validation selection, refitting, routing, or forecasting. Optional labels in raw rows are evaluation diagnostics only.

exact_reproduction_tolerances.discrete_fields: exact equality for the complete 225-row key grid, status, selected k, candidate k/status, component counts, fitted-component count, dimensions, transition counts, and train/validation/test counts

what_would_be_surprising: Any missing/non-ok row, any discrete mismatch (especially selected k), or any continuous or aggregate difference outside the frozen tolerances.
measurement_and_compute_matching_contrac: Use the current 15-system controlled and 10-system Dysts rosters, the historical data/selection/evaluation budgets exactly, one CPU task per system/seed, four CPUs and 8 GiB per task, and no GPU.
success_branch: Archive a portable compact packet and use it only as provenance-backed evidence that a serious label-free switching-style local polynomial EDMD control was already evaluated. Do not infer paired significance or a sparsity mechanism.
failure_branch: Do not use the historical baseline claim until the first row-level protocol or numerical mismatch is diagnosed and adjudicated.
ambiguity_branch: Inspect the authenticated row-level comparison, separating benign floating-point drift from route-count, data, or environment drift; do not relax tolerances after seeing the reproduction.
claim_limits: The baseline uses independently generated trajectories and only three configured seeds, so it is an unmatched descriptive reference.
No formal paired test against KAE rows is licensed.
Strong forecasting does not provide a support-alignment readout.
The result does not show that local EDMD is universally weaker, nor that sparsity alone causes a KAE advantage.
